observations: Photo 0 shows two controllers (black and white) placed on top of an Xbox console with 'XBOX' and 'SENTINEL TASK FORCE' visible on the front panel.
Photo 1 shows the same setup from a slightly different angle, with a QR code and 'AW CALL' visible on the console's front panel.
Photo 2 shows the same setup from a top-down angle, with the white controller on the left and black on the right, and the console's front panel with 'XBOX' and 'SENTINEL TASK FORCE' visible.
All photos show a watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI WILLIAMS GADGETS'.
The console appears to be a black Xbox console with a textured front panel, consistent with the 'Sentinel Task Force' theme.
The controllers are wired, as indicated by the presence of a USB port on the console and no visible wireless indicators.
No games are visible in any photo.
The console does not show any visible damage or wear in the photos.

identity.kind: Xbox console with two wired controllers

claims.evidence: The console has 'SENTINEL TASK FORCE' branding, which is not exclusive to a specific Xbox One model. The '1TB' capacity is not visible in any photo. The 'limited edition' claim cannot be verified from the photos alone.
No games are visible in any photo. The console does not show any game cases, discs, or digital game icons. The presence of games cannot be confirmed remotely.
Photo 0, 1, and 2 show two controllers placed on top of the console. Both controllers have a USB port visible, confirming they are wired.

risks.risk: The console may not be a genuine Xbox One or may be a counterfeit or non-functional unit.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the console's back panel showing the model number and serial number, or a video showing the console powering on and displaying the Xbox dashboard.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working or not genuine

risks.risk: The '1TB' capacity claim is unverified; the console may be a smaller model or have a different storage capacity.
risks.proof: A photo of the console's system information screen showing the storage capacity, or a video of the console booting up and displaying the storage details.
risks.if_unproven: priced as 500GB or lower capacity model

risks.risk: The 'limited edition' claim may be false or misleading; the console may be a standard model with a different theme.
risks.proof: A photo of the console's back panel showing the model number and edition details, or a video of the console's settings menu showing the edition.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a standard Xbox console without edition branding

risks.risk: The controllers may be non-functional or have damaged buttons/ports.
risks.proof: A video showing both controllers connecting to the console and responding to button presses.
risks.if_unproven: priced as controllers that may not work

risks.risk: The console may be missing essential components such as the power cable, HDMI cable, or other accessories.
risks.proof: A photo showing all included accessories laid out, including the power cable, HDMI cable, and any other cables or adapters.

proof_requests: Photo of the back of the console showing the model number and serial number.
Video of the console powering on and displaying the Xbox dashboard.
Photo of the console's system information screen showing storage capacity.
Photo of the console's settings menu showing the edition details.
Video of both controllers connecting to the console and responding to button presses.
Photo showing all included accessories, including power and HDMI cables.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
